candidates.title: 恢复与重授权之后的撤销保持
candidates.input_family: n个旧授权谱系、至少一个独立保留任务、一次恢复窗口、有限在途派生和声明提供方契约；最小例为A/B两个任务
candidates.output: 带明确范围的恢复计划与证据，或反例/UNKNOWN
candidates.security: root-epoch relative non-resurrection plus declared independent-task recoverability
candidates.primary_resource: 相同安全与合法恢复要求下的全部外部请求，另报可信持久状态和提供方能力成本
candidates.baseline: G1: full RAG/belief joint model + monotone authority/provenance + root-scoped fences/rebind + AID-Guard recovery, with identical interfaces and observations
candidates.minimal_example_kind: hypothetical recovery trace plus inherited indistinguishable stale-checkpoint pair
candidates.existing_native_fragment: old-RT revoke/refresh race with new AT active at AS only
candidates.main_gap: no same-premise composition guarantee or strict resource separation yet
candidates.next_check: single event-by-event native-contract and strong-baseline witness
candidates.baseline_integration_status: components exist; full proposed cross-paper composition not implemented or jointly proved in this project

candidates.title: 凭据证明缓存恢复分叉下的完整历史隐私
candidates.input_family: 完整凭据关系、m个接收者、h个恢复分支、固定允许泄漏与相同预计算/熵能力；完整合法协议族尚未构造
candidates.output: 合法刷新计划与完整安全证明，或转录区分/不可修复证据
candidates.security: knowledge soundness and full-history indistinguishability under matched public leakage
candidates.primary_resource: amortized offline/online group-field work and bytes including recovery, with same security parameter
candidates.baseline: G2: fresh randomness + equally preprocessed Vega rerandomization + applicable corrected rZK + generic common-complement synthesis
candidates.minimal_example_kind: inherited fixed-challenge two-coordinate affine response example
candidates.main_gap: missing complete legal-history mapping and same-contract advantage over reusable proving
candidates.next_check: recover CS03 artifacts and map complete game to Vega/rZK before implementation
candidates.baseline_integration_status: components exist; full proposed cross-paper composition not implemented or jointly proved in this project

candidates.title: 动态批准与恢复控制面的联合观测隐私
candidates.input_family: t个自适应请求、动态视图/批准/恢复事件、匹配允许泄漏的两历史和完整可见转录
candidates.output: 联合视图模拟/执行保证，或区分器/不可实现证据
candidates.security: specified full-trace leakage contract, distinct from relative injection simulatability
candidates.primary_resource: communication bytes/events and bounded delay at identical legitimate functionality, with padding and relay costs
candidates.baseline: G3: full-view VBP + control-sensitive IFC/declassification + same-output private state machine + matched padding/relay assumptions
candidates.minimal_example_kind: paper approval-event versus refresh-event distinguisher with matched final effect
candidates.main_gap: goal-strength difference only; no correct full-combination failure or strict same-function cost gap
candidates.next_check: formal mapping of dynamic visible events to VBP/IFC and allowed leakage
candidates.baseline_integration_status: components exist; full proposed cross-paper composition not implemented or jointly proved in this project
